entries.03117319e4a67fe1: The company, together with 18 subsidiaries and 1 other affiliated company, forms a group that develops, manufactures and sells products across 3 reportable segments: the Piping Systems Business, the Resin Business, and the Water Treatment and Resource Development Business.
entries.08d5d189105d6045: Of revenue of ¥80,081 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers by segment was ¥48,117 million for the Piping Systems Business, ¥22,977 million for the Resin Business and ¥8,987 million for the Water Treatment and Resource Development Business. By region, revenue was ¥49,539 million in Japan, ¥14,091 million in the United States and ¥16,452 million in other regions. Its major customer is Harrington Process Solutions LLC in the Piping Systems Business, with revenue of ¥8,550 million, exceeding 10% of total revenue.

entries.794f890033046bb2: It has formulated the medium-term management plan “GNT2030,” with fiscal 2030 as its final year, and its basic policies are to clarify three growth strategies and execute them steadily, to strengthen intangible assets such as human, intellectual and customer assets as drivers of growth, and to support growth from a financial standpoint while improving capital efficiency. It classifies its business portfolio into “Strengthen and Expand,” “Business Transformation” and “Deepen and Stabilize Growth,” and aims for continuous growth through measures suited to each.
